races.paceDynamic: Nordic Norm and Beta Reader will set a moderate early pace from the front, with no other confirmed pace-setters in this field of predominantly hold-up horses. The large contingent of hold-up runners (6 horses including Magical Merlin, Penfolds Grange, and Caph Star) will create significant traffic problems in the final 2f as they all attempt to make their moves simultaneously.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Nordic Norm and Beta Reader maintain an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The front two build an unassailable advantage as the hold-up horses leave their runs too late in the sprint finish. Nordic Norm's prominent style and Beta Reader's recent placed form give them the edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Favors Handy
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses encounter serious interference when making their moves
scenarios.body: Horses positioned just off the pace avoid the scramble and capitalize on the clear run. Caph Star and Penfolds Grange benefit from being able to pick their way through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Nordic Norm and Beta Reader go too fast early trying to build a big lead
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing the strongest finishers to sweep past. Magical Merlin and Billy Mill's proven hold-up patterns become decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits from Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a complete scramble with multiple horses impeding each other
scenarios.body: A horse at longer odds finds the clearest passage and capitalizes on the field's misfortune. King Of Charm or Chico Dulce could sneak through for place money.

watchPoints.text: Nordic Norm's early pace-setting - if he goes too fast or too slow it will dictate the entire race outcome
Traffic problems in the final 2f with six hold-up horses all needing room to make their runs simultaneously
Beta Reader's effectiveness over 1m after showing better recent form over 10f trips
Caph Star's ability to get competitive position from hold-up style given his perfect recent going record
Whether Magical Merlin can finally convert consistent placed efforts into a win at this level

races.paceDynamic: Pureis King will likely lead from the start with minimal early pressure, as the field is dominated by hold-up runners who prefer to come from behind. This creates a tactical race where the pace could be modest early, potentially favoring those who can get handy positions like Balzac and Winding Stream who have shown ability to track the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Pureis King sets a steady tempo without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows front-running tactics to work effectively over this mile trip. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Exposes Leader
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses press Pureis King early or the pace quickens significantly
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets softened up by honest pace, creating perfect conditions for closers with stamina. The race sets up ideally for those who can finish strongly over the mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Favors Handy
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very slow with riders waiting on each other
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops from the 2-furlong pole with positioning becoming crucial. Horses prominent early but not committed to leading gain the decisive advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantities Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced horses Fizzy Bear or Madame Passant show significant improvement
scenarios.body: The market principals fail to fire and one of the unproven runners capitalizes on favorable race conditions. Previous form gets turned on its head by unexposed ability.

watchPoints.text: Pureis King's stamina reserves over this mile trip as he has faded badly in recent finishes
Whether Fizzy Bear or Madame Passant show market support indicating stable confidence in their chances
How aggressively the hold-up horses are ridden early as positioning could be crucial in a large field
Winding Stream's ability to repeat recent winning form when stepping back up in class
Whether any horse attempts to press Pureis King early which would completely change the race dynamics

races.paceDynamic: Pints In Peace is the only confirmed early pace setter with Black Endeavour likely to sit just behind, creating a modest tempo in the early stages. With six hold-up horses led by Shafi, Deluded, and Lion Of Mali, this becomes a tactical affair where the pace could quicken significantly from halfway as the prominent pair try to steal a march on the patient brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Pints In Peace and Black Endeavour fail to maintain gallop after 4f
scenarios.body: The field bunches dangerously turning for home with hold-up horses still on the bridle. Lion Of Mali and Shafi emerge from the pack to capitalize on their superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Tempo Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Black Endeavour presses Pints In Peace from the 5f pole creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The early leaders stretch the field but tire in the final furlong, allowing late-running Deluded and Storm Point to sweep past. Deluded's recent 7f win over good ground gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Pints In Peace gets an easy lead with Black Endeavour tracking without pressure
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners kick clear entering the straight before the hold-up brigade can respond effectively. Pints In Peace's recent 7f success and Black Endeavour's 6f win suggest they can hold on from this tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses make their moves simultaneously at the 3f marker
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with Twilight Glow and Ahead Of Fashion joining the mix from their patient positions. Twilight Glow's OR 74 rating becomes decisive in a blanket finish where class tells.

watchPoints.text: Pints In Peace could get too easy a lead if Black Endeavour doesn't press early enough
Lion Of Mali's two recent wins make him dangerous if getting clear run from back markers
Deluded dropping significantly in grade after last-time win could find this too easy
Storm Point has only three recent runs but all show consistent effort on similar conditions
Twilight Glow needs strong pace to be effective but hasn't shown a place in recent similar going efforts

races.paceDynamic: Parisian Scholar will lead from the start with no early pressure, setting a measured gallop in this small field of predominantly hold-up horses. The lack of pace pressure means Starship Trooper may track closer than usual, while Moment Of Light, Green Falcon, and Devil's Peak will all need the race to develop into a sprint finish to show their best.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Parisian Scholar faces no serious challenge through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The leader maintains control throughout and has enough left to resist late challengers up the straight. His recent Kempton win shows he can dictate from the front successfully.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: All the hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a furious final two furlongs. Moment Of Light's perfect record on similar going gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Starship Trooper tracks the leader closely and kicks approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The only prominent runner uses tactical advantage to bridge the gap between early leader and closers. His recent third over course and distance suggests he's finding form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Parisian Scholar goes too fast early trying to build an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The leader empties his tank and gets swamped by all four closers in the final furlong. This becomes a straight fight between the hold-up horses with freshest finishing kick.

watchPoints.text: If Parisian Scholar goes off too fast in the opening half-mile, he'll be vulnerable to the quartet of closers
Moment Of Light needs to be held up longer than usual given the likely moderate pace
Starship Trooper's position after two furlongs will indicate whether he'll track the leader or drop back
The final two furlongs could see all four hold-up horses making their move simultaneously
Green Falcon and Devil's Peak both need the race to become a sprint to have realistic winning chances

races.paceDynamic: Chhota Saab will lead unopposed in this field with multiple prominent runners but no other natural front-runners. With Uniter, Lovethiswayagain, Arry Up, Fullstop, Anorah Unleashed and Runamara all likely to sit handy, the early pace should be genuine but sustainable. This setup favors either Chhota Saab if he can maintain his kick, or the hold-up horses Corniche Girl, Madman, Jungle Knight and Stock Market if the pace becomes strong enough.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Kicks
scenarios.trigger: If Chhota Saab gets an easy lead and the prominent pack doesn't pressure early.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the closers and Chhota Saab has enough left to resist late challenges. Lovethiswayagain and Arry Up pick up the pieces from their prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners Uniter, Lovethiswayagain and Arry Up pressure Chhota Saab early.
scenarios.body: The genuine pace sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses with Corniche Girl and Madman sweeping through late. Jungle Knight also benefits from the strong gallop despite his modest recent form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy horses can sit off Chhota Saab without getting involved in early pace battles.
scenarios.body: Lovethiswayagain or Arry Up get the perfect trip just behind the leader and have enough pace to kick clear. The hold-up horses don't get enough pace to close effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Fade Pattern
scenarios.trigger: If Chhota Saab sets steady fractions but multiple prominent runners get into a prolonged battle from 3f out.
scenarios.body: The early leaders all tie up in the final furlong allowing a closer like Corniche Girl to pick up the pieces. Stock Market could also benefit despite his fading tendencies if the pace is truly strong.

watchPoints.text: Chhota Saab getting an uncontested lead as he becomes very hard to pass despite his poor strike rate on this going.
Whether the prominent pack of Uniter, Lovethiswayagain and Arry Up will cooperate or pressure each other early.
Fullstop and Stock Market both showing their usual late fade patterns which would confirm the pace is adequate.
Corniche Girl's position turning for home as she needs to be within striking distance to use her proven finishing kick.
How quickly Madman begins his challenge as he needs time to wind up from his hold-up position.

races.paceDynamic: True Promise is the only confirmed front-runner in a field dominated by hold-up horses, giving him uncontested early control to set a sustainable tempo. With 9 of 10 runners preferring to come from off the pace, this creates a classic scenario where the leader can dictate fractions and kick clear before the cavalry charge arrives. The lack of pace pressure should see True Promise still traveling well turning for home, making the closers' task significantly harder.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise gets soft fractions and kicks clear early in the straight
scenarios.body: True Promise builds an unassailable lead as the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late on the sustained pace. The front-runner's tactical advantage proves decisive despite his modest recent form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or True Promise weakens markedly
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks with Em Four and State Of Madness having the class edge. Multiple runners converge in a bunched finish favoring the strongest stayers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise sets moderate fractions but multiple closers time their runs perfectly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no decisive tactical advantage, creating opportunities for consistent performers. Alpine Girl and Brazen Idol benefit from their recent winning form in similar conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites get caught in traffic or the pace becomes truly run to suit a swooper
scenarios.body: The tactical setup creates chaos allowing a horse like Ruby Red Gove or Middleton View to exploit gaps. Limited data horses like Ruby Red Gove thrive when the race falls apart tactically.

watchPoints.text: True Promise must be monitored early - if he faces any pace pressure or fails to break cleanly, the entire race dynamic changes
Watch for traffic problems in the straight with 9 hold-up horses likely converging simultaneously from the back
State Of Madness and Em Four need to be positioned handy enough to strike given their class advantage
Ruby Red Gove has minimal turf form data making her finishing kick unpredictable in this grade
Alpine Girl's recent 5f wins suggest she has pace to be closer than usual if needed tactically
